method: Assistant visual review of raw Qwen output against retained images and pre-inference descriptions. Pass means the main scene is correctly identified with no material unsupported detail found. Mostly right means useful main subjects with an unsupported or questionable detail. This subjective 20-photo spot check is not benchmark accuracy. Review includes full-resolution inspection.
annotation_caveat: Image 08's pre-inference wall/vines description was too specific. Full-resolution inspection supports weathered boards with leaves and plants; a deck or floor is plausible. The original annotation is preserved. Sunrise versus sunset cannot be established from images 06 and 07 alone.
